Coverage: Actual diff inspected; related inverse/reland duplicate hunks checked as a chain.
One changed test expectation (%5E to ^) for upstream nsStandardURL port. Bug discussion shows message display and read state effects beyond the URI assertion. Backout248 restores prior expectation; current endpoint still expects %5E.

    Bug 1899673 part 1 - Port bug 1873973: nsStandardURL incorrectly escapes ^ in the path. r=aleca

diff --git a/mailnews/imap/test/unit/test_imapUrls.js b/mailnews/imap/test/unit/test_imapUrls.js
index 286bf754419..2cde56ec98f 100644
--- a/mailnews/imap/test/unit/test_imapUrls.js
+++ b/mailnews/imap/test/unit/test_imapUrls.js
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@ function run_test() {
     uri.spec,
     "imap://user@localhost:" +
       IMAPPump.server.port +
-      "/fetch%3EUID%3E%5EINBOX%3E4294967168"
+      "/fetch%3EUID%3E^INBOX%3E4294967168"
   );
   teardownIMAPPump();
 }
